blocks.text: The Cloud Connector details page provides general, forwarding, and management information for a selected Cloud Connector. You can access the Cloud Connector details page by clicking the View icon () in the Cloud & Branch Connector Monitoring table (from the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Cloud Connector > Cloud Connector Overview) for a selected Cloud Connector.

blocks.heading: Analyzing the Cloud Connector Details Page

blocks.text: On the Cloud Connector details page, select a tab to view more details.

blocks.item: Deployment Details
Deployment Type: The cloud service provider used to deploy the selected Cloud account. The cloud service provider is either Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Group: The name of the group to which the Cloud Connector virtual machine (VM) is assigned.
Location: The location of the Cloud Connector Group.
Geo Location: The physical location of the Cloud Connector when deployed.
VM Size: The size of the VM, which is set to Small by default and is the only size currently supported.
Version: The version of the Cloud Connector.
Operational Status
Status: The operational status of the deployed Cloud Connector displayed as Active or Inactive
Last Upgrade Time: The date and time when the Cloud Connector was last upgraded
Last Seen Time: The date and time when the Cloud Connector was last seen
First Deployed Time: The date and time when the Cloud Connector was first deployed
Gateway Details
Management Default Gateway: The default gateway IP address
ZIA Gateway: The Internet & SaaS (ZIA) proxy gateway IP address
ZPA Broker: The default Private Access (ZPA) IP address
Internal Gateway IP Address: The internal gateway IP address
Cloud
Host ID: The host ID of the Cloud Connector
Virtual Network: The virtual private cloud (VPC) or VNet of the Cloud Connector
Sub-Network: The subnetwork of the Cloud Connector
Region: The region where the Cloud Connector is deployed
Availability Zone: The availability zone where the Cloud Connector is deployed
GWLB Service Name: The service name of the gateway load balancer
Auto Scaling: The status of autoscaling (i.e., True or False)
Security Groups: The security groups associated with the Cloud Connector VM
Account ID: The AWS account ID, the Azure subscription ID, or the GCP project name
Roles Assigned to CC: The IAM or access roles and permissions associated with the Cloud Connector
DNS Details
DNS Server 1: The primary DNS server IP address
DNS Server 2: The secondary DNS server IP address
Ingress Details
Virtual IP Address: The virtual IP address of the Cloud Connector.
Egress Details
Service IP Address 1: The primary service IP address
NAT IP Address: The NAT IP address
Outgoing Gateway IP Address: The outgoing gateway IP address
Management Details
Management IP Address: The management gateway IP address
NAT IP Address: The NAT IP address
Default Gateway IP Address: The default gateway IP address
DNS Details
DNS Server 1: The primary DNS server IP address
